_provenance: ai-feasibility-engineer output, persisted VERBATIM as returned on 2026-08-09. No field rewritten, renamed, trimmed or summarised.

verdicts.candidate: Guest contact triage and answer desk, AI on the language, rules on the money
verdicts.cost_of_error: Split by node, and the split is the whole design. A wrong ANSWER about the cancellation terms is the Moffatt fact pattern almost exactly (c44). White Pass has two clauses that are opposites separated by a preposition, a refund up to 24 hours prior minus a $10.00 per person penalty, and forfeiture of all rights to a refund within 24 hours of departure (c12). A paraphrase that flips up to and within is a money misstatement on the company's own site. A wrong ROUTING decision is much cheaper and asymmetric, a false positive costs an agent a few seconds of triage, a false negative leaves a Saturday night cancellation unflagged until Monday, by which time the 24 hour clock has run. So the confusion matrix is designed deliberately, recall on the time sensitive money class is the metric and over escalation is the accepted cost. The human review path is the reservation office inside Monday to Friday 7:00 AM to 3:00 PM Alaska Time (c10), which bounds what the acknowledgement is allowed to promise. It may confirm receipt and the timestamp. It may never state a refund outcome.
verdicts.data_readiness: Unusually good on the corpus, empty on the volume, absent on the eval set. WHAT EXISTS, a tiny, bounded, stable, single owner corpus of published pages, which is the precondition AI_SCOPING says almost nobody has. WHAT IS BROKEN IN IT, the corpus contradicts itself by omission, the cancellation page states no hours at all, the contact page carries no hours, the hours live only on product pages, and the nav link labelled FAQ points at the travel blog. Point retrieval at the site as it stands and the answer to when can I call to cancel is not on the cancellation page. A single governed source of policy text is therefore a PREREQUISITE and not a nice to have, and it is a content job with no model in it. WHAT DOES NOT EXIST, every number that would size this. WHAT WE CAN NEVER GET FROM OUTSIDE, the booking record. A booking reference can be CAPTURED as a string the guest types, with zero vendor dependency, and it can't be VALIDATED without an integration nobody can assess from outside the company. The strategist blurred capture and validation. NO EVAL SET EXISTS AND NONE CAN BE BOUGHT, since zero verbatim customer reviews were obtainable.
verdicts.step_math: As the strategist scoped it the model touches roughly seven nodes, so 0.95^7 is about 70 percent end to end and 0.90^7 is about 48 percent. Neither is shippable against a policy surface carrying c44 liability. As downscoped the model touches exactly ONE node, so there is no compounding at all. The safety property that makes this hold is that the arrival timestamp, the only thing that decides whether a guest sits inside or outside the 24 hour cutoff, is written by the server at intake BEFORE any model runs. A total classifier failure therefore degrades to today's behaviour plus a timestamp, a floor strictly above the status quo.
verdicts.evaluation: ACCEPTANCE METRIC, recall on the time sensitive money class measured against agent labels, with an explicitly accepted false positive rate, plus a hard assertion that every guest facing sentence about policy is a verbatim span from the approved corpus, which is a string containment check in code and not a judgment call. EVAL SET, does not exist and must be created from real inbound traffic. FALLBACK, on low confidence, on any language outside English Spanish and Japanese, or on any message mentioning money, hand the raw unmodified message to a human with its timestamp. Because the eval set does not exist yet, the model half is not scoped today, it is scheduled. Shipping it in 2026 would be a demo.
verdicts.change_or_reason: Keep the shape, strip three things and split it in two. STRIP GENERATION, serve the company's own published text verbatim with a link to the page it came from. Retrieval clears the bar, generation is a rung the problem never asked for. STRIP BOOKING VALIDATION, capture the reference as an unvalidated string. STRIP RUNTIME TRANSLATION OF ANYTHING THAT TOUCHES MONEY. THEN ANSWER THE DROPDOWN QUESTION HONESTLY, and the answer is not flattering to the original scope. A form with a dropdown does the whole job on the web channel, delivering the timestamp, the structured work item and the acknowledgement with zero AI. What a dropdown can't do is put itself on someone else's mail client. Inbound email is unstructured by definition and arrives in whatever language the guest writes. THAT is the irreducible messy input node, and it is narrower than the strategist claimed, one node on one channel rather than one node across the product. PHASE ONE SHIPS NO MODEL. PHASE TWO ADDS THE ONE CALL, trained and evaluated on labels the 2026 season produces for free.

verdicts.candidate: Self-service change and cancellation desk, deterministic, no AI on the path
verdicts.cost_of_error: High in dollars, low in unpredictability, which is the trade you want. A rule engine that miscomputes the 24 hour boundary or the $10.00 per person penalty is wrong identically every time, so it is catchable by exhaustive test rather than by luck. TIMEZONE, the office and the policy are published in Alaska Time while guests are on ships and in browsers set elsewhere, and a cutoff computed in the wrong zone silently moves real money. DAYLIGHT SAVING, and here the news is good and checkable, the published Summit season of April 30 to October 7, 2026 sits entirely inside a single US daylight saving period, so no transition falls within the season and that hazard is removed by the calendar rather than by code.
verdicts.data_readiness: The blocker, and it is structural rather than fixable by us. This candidate needs WRITE access to the ticketing system. The ticketing system is a hosted third party, no vendor, API or integration surface is published anywhere, and that integration can't be assessed from outside the company at all, which is RAND root cause two in plain sight. There is also a REACH CAP, guests who bought at a shore excursion desk sit in the cruise line's booking record, not the railway's.
verdicts.step_math: Not applicable, and saying so plainly is better than manufacturing a number. There are no probabilistic steps.
verdicts.evaluation: The best evaluability in the entire set. Acceptance is exhaustive, every case either side of the 24 hour line, the penalty arithmetic, the Alaska Time conversion, and the forfeiture clause, all as unit tests. Fallback, on any exception the desk does nothing to the booking and drops a timestamped work item into the same queue, so a failure degrades to the current phone process rather than to a wrong refund.
verdicts.change_or_reason: Sound engineering, correctly identified as needing no model, and correctly NOT first. Phase one of this candidate is not a build at all, it is a written feasibility assessment of the ticketing vendor's API, run in the off season, and the build is gated on that assessment coming back yes. Commissioning three and a half person months against an integration nobody has looked at is the classic way this fails. One standing instruction attaches for the life of this build, no model is ever introduced onto this path, in any phase, for any reason.

verdicts.candidate: Voice agent on the 1-800 reservation line
verdicts.cost_of_error: The worst in the set on every axis that matters. c44 applies with more force to voice, not less, because the guest keeps no artifact to re read. The phone is the published route for the highest stakes contact they have (c11), which means a voice failure lands directly on the money conversation. Peak call load also coincides exactly with the moment agents are pulled onto the platform (c30) on a day when five ships were listed arriving (c20), so a stall happens at maximum audience. One correction to the strategist's own reasoning, it leaned on c45 for voice, and c45 tested a TEXT chatbot. Transferring a text result to voice is an inference, not a measurement, and it should be labelled as one even though it points the same way.
verdicts.data_readiness: Nothing to build on and nothing to size with. No call volume is published anywhere. No call recordings, no transcripts, no intent taxonomy and no eval set exist. Latency rather than language is the hard constraint, smooth under about 800ms while many production systems land at 1400 to 1700ms, and that figure is vendor sourced so it frames the risk and is never quoted as established fact.
verdicts.step_math: Five or more probabilistic steps per turn and a multi turn call multiplies that again. At 95 percent per step a single five step turn is about 77 percent, and a four turn call compounds far below anything defensible on a refund conversation.
verdicts.evaluation: Cannot be stated today. No eval set, no baseline containment rate, no measured call volume, and eight weeks to season close would put it live at the busiest and thinnest staffed moment of the year with no tuning window. No evals, no promise.
verdicts.change_or_reason: REJECTION CONFIRMED on the evidence, and the 1.28 score understates the case rather than overstating it. THE CONCLUSION IT DOES NOT LICENSE, that the phone channel holds nothing. An out of hours greeting on the 1-800 line that states the published window and takes a callback request produces exactly the same timestamped record against the 24 hour cutoff that the whole target opportunity turns on. That is the phone channel's real win, it costs a phone system configuration rather than five person months, and it carries no model.

verdicts.candidate: Buy the commodity, an off-the-shelf tourism chat widget
verdicts.cost_of_error: Moderate, and one thing about it is routinely misunderstood in a way that is worth more to this prospect than the product recommendation itself. BUYING TRANSFERS THE BUILD, NOT THE LIABILITY. Air Canada argued its chatbot was a separate entity and the tribunal rejected that (c44). A vendor widget served on wpyr.com is information on wpyr.com. No vendor will lead with that and the strategist did not say it. Contained if configured to answer only published non money content and to hand off on anything touching cancellation, refund or price.
verdicts.data_readiness: Ready, and the readiest thing in the set. Pricing is a fact rather than a promise, $95 a month for 80 chats, $195 for 200 and $295 for 500, no fixed term contract, configuration over one to four weeks (c48). The named customer evidence is real and must be labelled every time, Black Cat Cruises reports about 500 conversations a month, around 60 percent of questions answered and 10 hours a month saved, VENDOR PUBLISHED and not independent, with the 10 hours the trustworthy figure and the modelled $3,750 never quotable as revenue (c47). The honest counterweight sits inside that same case study, only 10 percent of site visitors leave an email address. Black Cat runs up to four daily departures against almost 2,000 train starts a season here (c7), so the direction transfers and the magnitude does not.
verdicts.step_math: Single retrieval and answer turn, no chain, no autonomy, no state carried across a task. The compounding math barely applies, which is a genuine argument in its favour rather than a technicality.
verdicts.evaluation: The vendor's own containment figure of around 60 percent is a vendor published benchmark, not an acceptance bar we set for this company. A real acceptance bar is a scripted probe set built from their own published pages, run before go live, asserting that every cancellation, refund and price question hands off to a human. No fixed term contract means a failed trial costs a month.
verdicts.change_or_reason: Keep, as a component and a buy recommendation we are not paid for, which is the cheapest credibility available. MIT NANDA found buying from specialised vendors succeeded about twice as often as internal builds. It is complementary rather than rival, it answers questions on the website and it does NOT create a timestamped work item against the 24 hour clock and does not touch info@wpyr.com, which is where the survivor lives. TWO CONDITIONS RIDE WITH THE RECOMMENDATION AND ARE NOT OPTIONAL. One, configured to answer only published non money content and hand off on anything touching cancellation, refund or price. Two, the company is told plainly that under c44 the liability for what it says stays with them, whoever built it.

verdicts.cost_of_error: Genuinely low on the drafting, and the strategist read that correctly. A human sends every word, so there is no c44 guest facing surface. ONE EXCEPTION SWALLOWS THE TRANSLATION FEATURE. Agent approval of a Spanish or Japanese draft requires an agent who reads Spanish or Japanese. c31 is first party evidence that the capability is WANTED and is not evidence that it is PRESENT. A review path with no verified reviewer is not a review path, it is an approval click.
verdicts.data_readiness: Mixed. The published corpus exists and is fine. Booking context assembly needs the same blocked ticketing integration. Adoption data does not exist. The users are the same people who get pulled onto the platform (c30), which is the population least able to adopt a new internal tool mid season.
verdicts.step_math: Drafting is a single call with a human terminal check, so no compounding of consequence. Estimating a step count for an integration nobody has seen would be inventing a number.
verdicts.evaluation: Weak as proposed. Acceptance for a drafting aid is agent edit distance and time to send, both of which need a baseline that does not exist. McKinsey's finding that the biggest differentiator is fundamental workflow redesign cuts directly against an assistant bolted beside an unchanged workflow.
verdicts.change_or_reason: It largely dissolves, and the piece that survives is the piece with no AI in it. KEEP the single governed source of policy text, and note it is not a copilot feature at all, it is content governance and a hard PREREQUISITE for the survivor, so it moves into phase one there. KILL the booking context assembly on the blocked integration. KILL outbound Spanish and Japanese generation on the missing reviewer. DEFER reply drafting to phase two.

kill_list.capability: Runtime machine translation of any policy, price or refund text into Spanish or Japanese
kill_list.reason: The single most dangerous thing proposed anywhere in this package. c12 carries two clauses that are opposites separated by a preposition. A translation that swaps up to for within, softens forfeits all rights, or drops minus penalty is a money misstatement in a language nobody on the published staff list is confirmed to read back, on the company's own website, which is precisely what c44 was decided about. REPLACEMENT, translate the policy corpus and the acknowledgement templates ONCE with a professional human translator, version control them as fixed strings, re review only when the policy changes. Inbound machine translation for agent comprehension stays allowed, with the original text always retained beside it, because the direction is what makes it safe, an inbound aid has a human reader and an outbound string is an unreviewed statement.

kill_list.capability: Model generated answers about the cancellation policy, the 24 hour clock, the penalty or any refund outcome
kill_list.reason: Direct c44 exposure on the exact subject matter Moffatt turned on. Serve the company's own published text verbatim with its link, or hand off. A model may never tell a guest whether they are getting their money back.

Killed. Liability under c44 lands on the highest stakes contact they publish (c11), no call volume exists to size or evaluate against, per turn compounding and latency both stack against it, and eight weeks to the October 7, 2026 close would put it live at peak with no tuning window. The narrow real win on that channel is an out of hours greeting and callback capture, which is telephony configuration and carries no model.

kill_list.capability: Booking reference validation, booking lookup, seat release and anything that writes to the ticketing system, in phase one
kill_list.reason: tickets.wpyr.com is a hosted third party with no published API or integration surface, and the integration can't be assessed from outside the company. Capture the reference as an unvalidated string instead, which needs no vendor at all.

kill_list.capability: Agent style autonomy, multi step planning or any component that acts on a guest booking without a human
kill_list.reason: Nothing in this map is open ended. Every path is knowable in advance, which is Anthropic's own test for a workflow over an agent. Autonomy here would buy nothing and would put the compounding math on top of a c44 liability surface.

kill_list.capability: Shadow mode as an agent review exercise during the remaining 2026 season
kill_list.reason: Killed in that form and rebuilt. Asking the reservation agent to review AI drafts across the last eight weeks adds work to the exact person the whole outcome exists to unload, on the days five ships are in port and they are on the platform loading trains. The proposal contradicts its own goal.

No passenger count, no load factors, no trains per day and no channel split are published, so there is no demand signal to model. Amtrak's ARROW achieved 3 to 5 percent (c43), which is a real precedent and not a substitute for this company's own data. Pricing is also negotiated with cruise lines, one of whose parent is a minority partner in the ownership group (c5), so it is a commercial relationship before it is an algorithm.

kill_list.capability: Predictive maintenance on the locomotive fleet
kill_list.reason: Six 30 class engines currently in Skagway with the seventh and eighth due in 2026 (c36) is the entire evidence base. No telemetry, no failure history and no cited maintenance pain exist anywhere in the file. Proposing it would be inventing a need.

kill_list.capability: Anything touching the terms, scheduling or monitoring of the represented workforce
kill_list.reason: About 40 workers voted to join SMART TD's local chapter on April 8 (c33). That is a negotiation before it is a deployment. Reservation Agents are not among the roles named in that article, and not named in an article is not the same as not represented, so it is confirmed with the company rather than assumed.

kill_list.capability: A shore excursion settlement or reconciliation build
kill_list.reason: Shoretime is built specifically for this workflow, partnered with Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings since February 20, 2024, and it makes no artificial intelligence claim anywhere on its site (c41). The people closest to this exact workflow, with every commercial incentive to say AI, are not saying it. This is a buy evaluation, not an Alaska AI build.

recommended_pick.name: Out of hours guest request capture and triage desk, timestamp first, model second
recommended_pick.why_it_survives: PHASE ONE CONTAINS NO ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE AT ALL, and that is the recommendation rather than a caveat attached to one. The highest value thing this company can build is a server written arrival timestamp on a structured request, because the guest's money sits on a 24 hour clock with a $10.00 per person penalty and forfeiture of all rights inside it (c12), while the only published route to act runs Monday to Friday 7:00 AM to 3:00 PM Alaska Time (c10) and requires a phone call (c11). The gap between a 24 hour clock and a 40 hour service week is the whole opportunity, and closing it is a form, a clock and a queue. WHAT PHASE ONE SHIPS, a structured web form with dropdowns and a booking reference field, served in English, Spanish and Japanese as human translated fixed strings (c31), which writes a timestamped work item. An out of hours greeting on the 1-800 line stating the published window and taking a callback request, producing the same timestamped record on the channel where their habit already lives (c11). An ingest on info@wpyr.com that timestamps and queues the raw message unchanged, which matters because that is the inbox the ticketing system itself directed customers to on the day we looked (c19, point in time, could be transient, never a standing condition). A single governed source of policy text, which fixes the cancellation page carrying no hours while the product pages do. Pre translated acknowledgement templates that confirm receipt and the timestamp and never state a refund outcome. Every one of those is deterministic and exhaustively testable, and Google's Rule of ML number one is that a heuristic gets you most of the way there. WHAT PHASE ONE ALSO DOES, and this is why it is first rather than merely cheap, it is the measurement instrument. It produces the four counters that do not exist today, out of hours contact volume, arrival time relative to the 24 hour cutoff, language mix and intent mix, and it produces them as a by product of the agent doing the job they already do, at zero added workload. HONEST SHADOW MODE, restated. The strategist's version asks the agent to review AI drafts during peak, which loads the person the project exists to unload. The honest version ships no model in 2026, captures every request and every agent resolution, and the agent's own answer becomes the label for free. Two caveats ride with it and were missing. The calendar says eight weeks to October 7, 2026, and the USABLE observation window is shorter, because building, access to info@wpyr.com and configuration all come out of the same eight weeks. And late season traffic is a SHOULDER SEASON SAMPLE, since Bennett closes September 12 (c17) and the Summit season carries no service dates on September 26 to 27 and October 1 and 3 to 5 (c16), so a question mix measured in September describes a shoulder season and not a July peak, and it must be labelled that way before anyone designs 2027 on it. WHERE THE MODEL FINALLY ARRIVES, phase two, off season build, live before the 2027 opening. ONE call on ONE node, classifying and extracting from unstructured free text that arrives by email and in the form's free text box, biased hard toward over escalation because a missed Saturday night cancellation costs the guest the fare while a false alarm costs an agent seconds. Language understanding is squarely inside Google PAIR's good fit list, keyword rules break on multilingual and indirect phrasing, and the timestamp is already written before the model runs, so a total classifier failure degrades to today's behaviour plus a timestamp. WHAT MAKES THIS A CREDIBLE FIVE PERCENT PROJECT rather than a pilot, a narrowly defined problem tied to a real decision, a corpus that already exists and is unusually small and clean, an acceptance bar set before the model is built, and a workflow the model is placed inside rather than beside. Alongside it we recommend they price the off the shelf widget at $95 to $295 a month (c48), which we are not paid for, with the plain warning that under c44 the liability for what it says stays with them.

where_not_to_use_ai: We deliberately kept AI off the money. The 24 hour refund clock and the $10.00 per person penalty are applied by code that can be tested exhaustively, the arrival timestamp that decides whether a guest is inside or outside that clock is a server write and never a model output, the Spanish and Japanese policy text is translated once by a human and stored as fixed strings rather than generated on the fly, and a model never tells a guest whether they are getting their money back.
honest_flags: Nothing in this study may be sized. No channel split, no passenger count, no trains per day, no year round versus seasonal headcount split and no call or email volume is published anywhere, so the reach of every candidate rests on a number nobody has published. The first job of the recommended build is to produce that number, which is why it is framed as a measurement before it is framed as a saving.

The ticketing observation is point in time. On 2026-08-09 the system returned an unavailable message, seen by three independent same day observers, and it could be transient. It is never presented as a standing condition, and no part of the recommendation depends on it being one.

Late season traffic is a shoulder season sample. Bennett closes September 12, 2026 and the Summit season carries no service dates on September 26 to 27 and October 1 and 3 to 5, so any question mix captured before the October 7 close describes a shoulder period and generalises to one.

The eight week runway is calendar time, not usable observation time. Build, access to the inbox and configuration all come out of the same eight weeks. The strategist's framing leaned toward urgency, which is the same direction the fact checker's named drift pattern runs, so it is corrected here rather than repeated.

Zero verbatim customer reviews were obtainable, every platform returned HTTP 403. We hold no sample of how these guests actually phrase anything, so the assumed question mix is an assumption and no eval set exists or can be bought.

c45 handling. The two main effects were significant and the INTERACTION effect was statistically insignificant. It does not prove chatbots specifically lose the sale when the news is bad. It also tested a text chatbot, so applying it to voice is an inference and is labelled as one.

c46 handling. Fortune reported the figures in its own voice, not as an executive quote. Chipotle is enormous, so the direction transfers and the magnitude does not, and it is a hiring context rather than a guest service one, which is a second mismatch on top of the size caveat.

c47 handling. The Black Cat Cruises figures are vendor published and not independent. The 10 hours a month is the trustworthy figure, the modelled $3,750 is never quotable as revenue, and only 10 percent of site visitors leave an email address, which cuts against capture optimism.
Four claims were not re verified this pass and none of them carries weight in this verdict, c50, c51, c53 and c49.

The absence of a published IT lead is an unverified inference about capability. It is used ONLY to shape delivery toward managed, low maintenance builds, and it is never stated as a fact about the company.

The union constraint is live. Reservation Agents are not among the roles the article names, which is why the survivor appears clear of it, and absence from that list is not proof of non representation, so it is confirmed with the company before anything ships.

Buying does not transfer liability. Under c44 the company is responsible for what its own website says regardless of who built it, and the tribunal explicitly rejected the separate entity argument. That applies to the off the shelf widget exactly as it applies to anything we would build.

There is currently no verified Spanish or Japanese reader on the published staff list. c31 is recruiting language, which is evidence the capability is wanted and not evidence it is present, so any outbound guest facing text in those languages has no review path today and is served as human translated fixed strings instead.
